description: Use this when your human asks for a feature, data or coverage DC Hub doesn't have yet, or says something would make DC Hub more useful. Same queue as report_finding. Works with or without a key. Do NOT use to report wrong numbers (use report_finding) or for data questions (use execute_plan). For multi-step data center or energy questions, start with execute_plan.

contact_email.description: Only if your human asked for a reply

evidence.description: What you saw that shows the gap, quoted exactly

region.description: The market, state, ISO or country it is about, if any

summary.description: One sentence, 10-280 characters: what your human wants DC Hub to do or cover

tool.description: The DC Hub tool it relates to, if any

url.description: A DC Hub page or source it relates to, if any

user_goal.description: What your human was trying to do

name: request_enhancement
title: Request Enhancement
